basis: The off-builder (hosted) Agent route of scripts/host-app-release.py --hosted, run by os-release.yml modes agent-hosted and agent-hosted-probe on GitHub-hosted runners (scripts/agent-hosted.py). The signing values and pin are the committed Frankel route's, unchanged (os/release-pipeline/frankel.json; Signing's #608 contract). App owns the portable SDK, JDK and tools: absolute paths on the hosted runner, bound at run time by App's portable-build.py inputs record, with no builder source root, so they stay null here. The public connection inputs are the pinned public Rose Agent APK's (publicInputs). The reservation store is the off-builder atomic app version ledger Frankel and Agent share (decision D1); a hosted allocation refuses until the Frankel builder has recorded its own consumed versions there as a floor (decision D2). No value here is a placeholder, and nothing is inferred from a field name.

reservation.basis: Decision D1 (Release, 2026-11-07, under Chief's delegation of access, credentials, signing and publishing): one annotated tag per versionCode in pixel-ota, the repository whose rose-agent-N releases the versions name. The ref is created only if absent (HTTP 422 otherwise), so one run ever holds a version, whichever lane asks first. It is written with the existing pixel-ota publisher App (contents: write), whose token is minted only in hosted jobs and never reaches a builder, and read with git, anonymously, by any lane. pixel-ota has no workflows, so a ledger tag triggers nothing; ledger tags are not releases, so the OTA feed, Latest and the app's release listing never see them. scripts/app_reservation_store.py holds the format.

publicInputs.basis: The connection inputs every published Rose Agent carries, taken from one public, immutable release asset instead of a builder directory or Git (the five stay git-ignored deployment files): rose-agent-352 (352-auto-beta, candidate ff26d75c, published prerelease, the newest rose-agent release on 2026-11-07). Its stored entries (connection, clipboard and the raw certificate) are byte-identical to those of the Rose Agent 368 that Frankel 2026110704 and 2026110705 bundle (signed-apps of app-inputs-export run 42408244069), and both APKs' compiled res/xml/mac_screen_network.xml are byte-identical (cb086353...). The network security config source is regenerated with App's scripts/configure-local.py template for the endpoint host, and every hosted build must compile it back to that exact entry (agent-hosted.py check-apk), so the hosted Agent carries the same connection inputs as the published one. A new endpoint or input set is a new pin. mac-screen-connection.json left the public inputs in #684 (host-app-build.RETIRED_ASSETS); the pinned APK still carries it, but nothing reads it there and the hosted build neither restores nor checks it.
